issues.where: the whole wet foreground flat, bottom two thirds of the frame
issues.what: the ground texture is smeared into long parallel streaks like stretched wood grain or motion-blurred paint, a projected texture stretched across the plane; it reads as CG at once
issues.fix: replace with a properly UV'd or triplanar wet sand/silt material with real ripple marks and grain at camera distance

issues.where: the shallow flat between the pool and the gravel bench, middle band of the frame
issues.what: same stretched swirly wood-grain texture across the flat, with grey flat-tint water patches pasted on top with no depth, no wet edge and no meniscus
issues.fix: rebuild the shallows as real thin water over sand: depth-based colour, wet darkened margins, ripple-cast reflections, consistent sand texture

issues.where: all the animals, especially the near drinking one and the calf
issues.what: smooth untextured clay-like models with blobby legs and no hooves, the calf's head fuses into its neck; pose and shape read as a sculpt or game asset, not a living animal
issues.fix: model real anatomy (joints, hooves, musculature, skin folds), add hair/fur groom and grime, vary poses

issues.where: the reflections and the water/ground boundary, lower middle
issues.what: reflections are wavy squiggle shapes that do not match the bodies above, and the water stops on a hard straight horizontal line against a grey noise ground with no wet edge, foam or crust
issues.fix: ray-trace reflections against a correct water surface, blend the waterline with a damp gradient, mud and ripples around legs

issues.where: crop x 0-17% y 58-75%, the near foreground rock
issues.what: rock is a faceted low-poly lump with a smeared, stretched texture; looks like plastic or clay, also soft at the closest range
issues.fix: use a high-detail scanned or displaced rock with sharp micro-detail and proper texel density at camera distance

issues.where: crop x 83-100% y 58-75%, the near right boulder
issues.what: flat faceted planes with a stretched striped texture, no erosion or grain
issues.fix: replace with displaced, high-resolution rock asset

issues.where: crop x 83-100% y 25-42%, the overhang/cave on the right
issues.what: shadow is an almost pure black flat region with no bounce light from the bright ground and sky
issues.fix: raise indirect bounces and add fill so the cave floor and walls show detail

issues.where: crop x 42-58% y 25-42%, the cliff face
issues.what: blotchy dark stains and straight vertical streak decals repeated on the wall; cliff reads as a painted texture on a flat wall with a perfectly arched cave opening
issues.fix: break up decals, add real geometric relief, ledges, fallen debris and varied staining

issues.where: crop x 42-58% y 58-75%, animals in the shallows
issues.what: distant animals are smooth pale mannequins with stiff, near-identical poses; legs stand on the water with no ripple, splash or wet on the legs
issues.fix: vary poses, add contact ripples and wet darkening on legs, better models

issues.where: crop x 42-58% y 25-42%, the reflection under the animal's belly
issues.what: a shape in the reflection reads as a face-like form that matches nothing above it
issues.fix: check reflection source; remove the stray object or fix the reflection

issues.where: crops x 0-17% and x 83-100% y 25-42%, animal skins
issues.what: tiling noise texture with visible hard polygon silhouette edges on the legs and a flat sharp seam where leg meets belly
issues.fix: smooth the mesh, add subsurface and fur, remove seams

issues.what: flat grey fill with fine horizontal streak noise, no depth, no seen bottom, reflections are abstract brown blobs
issues.fix: use proper water shader with Fresnel, depth absorption and coherent reflections

issues.where: crops at y 25-42%, the far horizon line
issues.what: the far shore is a hard thin dark band with a white line on top and a noisy grey strip above it; distance has no air or haze gradient
issues.fix: add aerial perspective, soft depth haze and a real far shoreline

issues.where: the mist along the far shore
issues.what: fog is a flat even tint band with no volume or light in it
issues.fix: use volumetric mist with density variation and light scatter from the low sun

issues.what: the stretched striped grain is visible at native size, with fine parallel lines like a texture stretched along one axis
issues.fix: fix UV stretch / projection on the ground plane

issues.where: the pool edge at mid frame
issues.what: the pool has an unnaturally clean, straight, raised lip, like a geometric cut in the plane
issues.fix: blend the pool edge into the flat with irregular, wet margin
